nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in ERC20Basic and set to 2*10**27 in the DAEXToken constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance; read by balanceOf, mutated by transfer and by the DAEXToken constructor.
Nested mapping owner => spender => amount; written by approve and read by allowance.
Constant public token name 'DAEX Token'.
Constant public token symbol 'DAX'.
Constant public token decimals value 18.
Public address that receives the whole initial supply; set once in the constructor.
Public transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): requires positive value and sufficient balance, debits msg.sender, credits _to, emits Transfer.
Public constant balanceOf(address _owner): returns balances[_owner].
Public approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): requires value==0 or current allowance==0, sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender], emits Approval.
Public constant allowance(address _owner, address _spender): returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
Constructor taking address _target; sets target, totalSupply = 2*10**27 and balances[target] = totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used as the source of funds in transfer and as the allowance owner key in approve.
Unchecked subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer; Solidity ^0.4.17 without SafeMath risks integer underflow.
Unchecked addition balances[_to] += _value in transfer; risks integer overflow and balance inflation.
Recipient address parameter of StandardToken.transfer.
Amount parameter of StandardToken.transfer, flows into both balance mutations.
Address whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Spender address parameter of approve, used as the second key of allowed.
Allowance amount parameter of approve, written into allowed.
Owner address parameter of allowance.
Spender address parameter of allowance.
Address parameter of the DAEXToken constructor; becomes the initial token holder.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the mapping entry that is decremented by _value in transfer.
_value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without SafeMath protection.
_value is added to balances[_to] without SafeMath protection.
_to indexes the recipient mapping entry incremented in transfer.
The unchecked decrement writes the balances state mapping.
The unchecked increment writes the balances state mapping.
transfer executes the debit of the sender balance.
transfer executes the credit of the recipient balance.
_value is the argument consumed by the transfer require check and mutations.
_to is the argument consumed by the transfer routine.
_owner is used as the lookup key in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
_spender is used as the second key of allowed in approve.
_value is the amount written into allowed by approve.
msg.sender determines which allowance slot approve modifies.
msg.sender is the first key used when approve reads and writes allowed.
_spender is the second key used on the allowed mapping in approve.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
_owner is the first lookup key in allowance.
_spender is the second lookup key in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
_target is the constructor argument.
Constructor assigns _target to the target state variable.
Constructor assigns the fixed supply to totalSupply.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances[target].
Constructor execution order sets target before minting.
Constructor execution order mints balances after totalSupply is set.
msg.sender is the implicit caller whose balance transfer manipulates.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer and has no independent state.
_value is the operand directly consumed by the unchecked balance arithmetic.
_owner is a transient lookup key used only inside balanceOf.
_spender is a transient key used only inside approve.
_value is the transient allowance amount written only by approve.
_owner is a transient lookup key used only inside allowance.
_spender is a transient lookup key used only inside allowance.
_target is a constructor argument immediately stored in target and balances.
